title: openwiz.service.v1
description: OpenWiz's always-on service (OpenWiz 0.0.8): its status report, config, state and GitHub records, told apart by schema. Times are integer milliseconds, durations integer seconds. contracts/service.v1.md has the check table, the two-tries rule and the rules this schema can't express.

loop_approval_text.description: Nonblank Unicode text without NUL; positive ranges exclude Unicode White_Space from the required nonblank character.

loop_approval_ref.description: Canonical private GitHub issue/PR comment URL; setup verifies the comment is private and explicitly approves the entire exact binding. Repository path must be an ordinary component.

loop_approvals.description: LP1 required loops.approvals record, installed by Jake’s setup only after explicit approval. Empty admits nothing. Duplicate or conflicting bindings refuse the entire record; every repository/project must match the installation. Enclosing config registration belongs to L12.

loop_limits.description: LP1 required loops.limits record: loop checks and original agents only; maxima include urgent reserves. Enclosing config registration belongs to L12.

ms.description: Integer milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

seconds.description: A duration in whole seconds, at least 1.

port.description: 1 to 65535. The maximum is the md's rule: this checker has no maximum keyword.

github_id.description: A GitHub App's or installation's id: not a secret.

commit.description: A full commit id: 40 lowercase hex digits.

id.description: A CloudRoom id (thread, loop, project): the adapter's rule, 1 to 128 ASCII letters, digits, _ or -, not starting with -.

op_id.description: A send op id: 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, _ or -, starting with a letter or digit.

incident_id.description: i, then a number without leading zeros.

gap.description: The inventory's eight gap kinds, and cloudroom_not_running.

loop.description: One of OpenWiz's loops: its name starts launch-fleet and names the configured repository.

unknown.description: The subject couldn't be read: nothing changes.

result_loop_unread.description: The check's list couldn't be read: one result, no subject.

result_fleet_thread_unread.description: The check's list couldn't be read: one result, no subject.

interrupted.description: The service stopped before it learned how the try went.

saved_try.description: outcome is null only while the command runs; comment is null until the record's comment id is saved.

saved_takeover_try.description: outcome is null only while the command runs; comment is null until the record's comment id is saved.

pass.description: One health pass: a result for each subject, the fixes it made due, and the incidents it made a Needs you due for.

switched.description: The new build passed its tests and now runs.

kept.description: The old build still runs: the step that failed, and why.

update_attempt.description: from: the build that was running; to: the commit of main it tried.

state.description: service/state.json: written only by the service.

loops.description: Optional L12 composition; both setup-owned records are required for loop admission. Absence enables no loop execution.

config.description: service/config.json: written by Jake's setup, never by the service.

operator.description: Optional explicit local operator identity set at install. Switch writes require it and refuse blank or NUL-containing values. Never inferred from an owner or request.

events.description: Optional existing repository webhook delivery polling. Absent leaves intake off; hook_id is explicit, never discovered.

decision_repositories.description: Optional explicit decision-feed roles; absent uses cwd as the single repository. Roles must differ case-insensitively.

updateChannel.description: Private installation metadata; absence preserves the source default. Parsed separately from service documents.

done_service_takeover.description: TK1: the service tick owns the fleet after confirmed retirement of its exact old loop.

retired_loop.description: Saved takeover intent and confirmed retirement; loop IDs stay reserved across restarts.

public_takeover_outcome.description: Public projection only; private saved takeover_outcome retains operational thread identities.

name.description: One ordinary repository path component; neither dot nor dot-dot.
